title: Book Two · Chapter 71: A Table Without a Wobble
story:
On Saturday, Dad works on a small table at Mr Sun's place. Ronan arrives with Mum after the morning shopping. The table stands on four square legs, but one corner moves under Dad's hand.

“Short leg?” Ronan asks.

“Maybe,” Dad says. “Watch first.”

Dad turns the table. He sets it on a clear, flat part of the floor. The same corner still moves. Then he lifts one side and checks the joint underneath.

Ronan looks at the foot. It seems as long as the others. Dad shows him a narrow gap near the top.

“This part moves.”

“Can you put something under the foot?”

“It would still move here.”

Dad asks Ronan to carry the clean cloths to the counter. Then he takes the table to his bench. Ronan stays on the other side. Mum needs a small chair for her work room. She talks to Mr Sun about it. They look at its height together.

Dad checks the loose joint and explains the repair to Mr Sun. The owner wants the table back tomorrow. But the joint needs time to set. Mr Sun takes the card. He will ask the owner about another day.

Ronan looks at the table again. “Can we see it finished?”

“Come on Monday,” Dad says. “You can help check it.”

On Monday afternoon, Ronan returns with Mum. The table stands in the same clear space. Dad puts a small wooden block on top. He presses the opposite corners. The block stays still.

“Your turn.”

Ronan presses gently. No corner drops. He walks around and tries again. Then Dad checks the joints once more.

The owner arrives before they leave. She sets her bag on the table. Then she takes it off. She tests each corner herself. She smiles when it stays level.

“I can use both hands on it now,” she says.

Mr Sun finishes the card. Dad and another adult carry the table to the door. Ronan holds the door clear. The customer thanks him too.

On the way home, he tells Mum about the table. “Dad did not need a block under the foot.”

“He found the moving part,” she says.

Ronan thinks about the small gap under the table. From above, he could not see it at all.

At supper, Dad's hand reaches for the salt. Ronan presses a corner of their kitchen table. It stays still.

“Can we eat first?” Dad asks.

Ronan puts his hand back. Mum gives him the salt. Ronan has no time for another test.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

joint＝接合处；level＝平稳的；leg＝桌腿。

## 理解问题

1. Dad发现桌子晃动的真正原因是什么？
2. Ronan能参加哪部分工作？

## 读句子

**Dad / turns / the table.** Dad／转动／那张桌子。
